failure.body:
#### Description

Chassisd fails on supervisor on Nokia 7250, leading to syncd/swss not starting up. Backtrace seen on the syslog is as follows:

```
2024 Dec 10 <IPV6>.137945 svcstr-7250-sup-1 INFO pmon#supervisord 2024-12-10 <IPV6>,137 INFO success: chassisd entered RUNNING state, process has stayed up for > than 10 seconds (startsecs)

2024 Dec 10 <IPV6>.544727 svcstr-7250-sup-1 INFO pmon#supervisord: chassisd Traceback (most recent call last):

2024 Dec 10 <IPV6>.544727 svcstr-7250-sup-1 INFO pmon#supervisord: chassisd   File "/usr/local/bin/chassisd", line 710, in <module>

2024 Dec 10 <IPV6>.545539 svcstr-7250-sup-1 INFO pmon#supervisord: chassisd     main()

2024 Dec 10 <IPV6>.545753 svcstr-7250-sup-1 INFO pmon#supervisord: chassisd   File "/usr/local/bin/chassisd", line 705, in main

2024 Dec 10 <IPV6>.545938 svcstr-7250-sup-1 INFO pmon#supervisord: chassisd     chassisd.run()

2024 Dec 10 <IPV6>.545949 svcstr-7250-sup-1 INFO pmon#supervisord: chassisd   File "/usr/local/bin/chassisd", line 683, in run

2024 Dec 10 <IPV6>.546348 svcstr-7250-sup-1 INFO pmon#supervisord: chassisd     self.module_updater.module_db_update()

2024 Dec 10 <IPV6>.546558 svcstr-7250-sup-1 INFO pmon#supervisord: chassisd   File "/usr/local/bin/chassisd", line 279, in module_db_update

2024 Dec 10 <IPV6>.546731 svcstr-7250-sup-1 INFO pmon#supervisord: chassisd     if self.my_slot == int(module_info_dict['slot']):

2024 Dec 10 <IPV6>.546891 svcstr-7250-sup-1 INFO pmon#supervisord: chassisd                        ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

2024 Dec 10 <IPV6>.546902 svcstr-7250-sup-1 INFO pmon#supervisord: chassisd ValueError: invalid literal for int() with base 10: 'A'
```

This is due to this PR : https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-platform-daemons/pull/560 , and the fact that nokia uses characters (eg. A, B, C etc.) for its slot name.

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Start a nokia 7250 on 202405.17
2. Note that syncd / swss does not start

#### Describe the results you received:
No syncd containers running

#### Describe the results you expected:
syncd starts as expected

#### Output of `show version`:
20240510.17
```
(paste your output here)
```
#### Output of `show techsupport`:

```
(paste your output here or download and attach the file here )
```

#### Additional information you deem important (e.g. issue happens only occasionally):

resolution.title: [chassisd] Address the chassisd crash issue and add UT for it
resolution.description:
#### Description
On Nokia platform, slot name of Supervisor is string "A" instead of a number. Using "int" to convert it could cause issue backtrace.   We should use slot value to any checking without any conversion. This will fixes  https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/21131

#### Motivation and Context
Modify the _get_module_info not to convert "slot" to a string value.  And also modify the code not to convert slot value to an to do any checking.  Just directly use the returned value of get_slot().  Also add UT  test_moduleupdater_check_slot_string() to valid it.

#### How Has This Been Tested?

Tested on 202405 branch
